wiki.summary: Track 8 off of God Save The Three Let's Link Up and Die is a solo track, featuring only glaive. It contains the lyrics ”I heard that lil’ diss you made. You need more to say to upset the boy”. Which could be a jab at artist midwxst’s track 6/17/20 which talks about glaive being a shitty friend. Read more on Last.fm.
